description: This file defines the MemoryAdapterReceiver class, which implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface for handling message queues in Orleans streaming. It manages message retrieval, monitoring, and shutdown procedures for memory-based stream queues.

classes.name: MemoryAdapterReceiver<TSerializer>
classes.description: A generic class implementing IQueueAdapterReceiver for managing memory stream queue messages, including initialization, message retrieval, and shutdown.

methods.name: MemoryAdapterReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the memory adapter receiver with dependencies.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver, tracking the process via receiverMonitor.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves messages from the queue, tracks performance and message count, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges message delivery; currently a no-op.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, waiting for pending tasks and tracking the shutdown process.

methods.name: LogErrorGetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during message retrieval.
